chapter: Army service and after the war
title: Playing the officers' club to avoid bivouac
summary: At Camp Stewart, Georgia, he never joined the band, playing the officers' club and slipping out of rough exercises.

story.theme_name: Drafted: musicians in the military and the war years
story.community_name: Drafted: service bands, USO shows and the war years

blocks.x: But you did get -- didn't you tell me you got transferred to Florida or to a band or something?
No, no, I never was transferred to a band.

No, never was transferred. Now, the only thing that I did while I was in the service was this. I was in A Company, and I knew that I didn't want to -- I knew my feet was flat and I knew how long I would last out there.

So I tried to get in the Special Service any way possible. So I would go over to the officer's club, and just play for the officer's club and get me a few drinks at night. So the officers, they got so -- well, this old boy is pretty good, he comes over and plays for us and so on and so on. Tell him it's going to be a rough day tomorrow and stay here.

So one of those guys come and says, well, look here, it's going to be rough tomorrow. If you're around in the area you got to go. Say, yeah? So then I'm going up to another area and sleep up there, and then come back down to my barracks after everybody's gone.
No, you know what I mean. They said, well, you can come up and play for us, so we treat you pretty nice, you know what I mean.
So, you mean, the other guys were called up and shipped out?
No, no. No, this is the way it was. You see, say we're going on bivouac tomorrow. We're going to sleep on the ground.
Oh, yeah, I see what you mean.
You're going to get out where all of them snakes -- now, I was in Georgia, and we're getting out with all them snakes and all that stuff, on that grass and water and stuff.

So they say, it's going to be a rough one tomorrow. Say, everybody goes. Say, if you're around there, you'll go. There's my cue to get out. So I never -- in those days, I would never show. They'd call my name, where is he? Nobody could find me.
